Your Support at Work

Where Funds Go

We use Booster Club funds to help purchase items for St. Elmo's students to enjoy.

St. Elmo Experience Nights

Materials, supplies, activities, and special experiences for students and families.

Student Supplies & Resources

Additional instructional materials, hands-on learning supplies, enrichment resources, and student needs when school funds are limited.

Teacher Supplies & Classroom Needs

Supporting teachers with materials and resources needed to enhance instruction and student learning.

Staff Appreciation

Treats, meals, appreciation gifts, celebrations, and activities to recognize and support our amazing St. Elmo staff.

Student of the Day Prizes

Small prizes and special recognition items to celebrate students who demonstrate outstanding character and achievement.

Field Trips & Student Experiences

Contributions toward field trips, special activities, educational experiences, and enrichment opportunities for students.

Enrichment & Special Projects

Supporting programs, projects, clubs, and activities that enhance the St. Elmo experience.

General St. Elmo Activity Fund

Fundraising proceeds may be placed into the general activity fund to support student needs, supplies, field trips, and other school-related expenses throughout the year.

Schoolwide Events & Celebrations

Helping provide materials, activities, and resources for special events and celebrations.

Additional Student & School Needs

Providing support when unexpected needs arise or when additional resources can make a meaningful difference for St. Elmo's students.
